title: Energy Efficient College Building
subtitle: Integrated planning, structural design & energy optimisation
scope: Planning  Structural Design  Energy Simulation  Estimation  G+2  ~24,000 sq.ft
summary: Designed an energy-efficient G+2 educational facility using an integrated BIM workflow, covering site analysis, architectural planning, structural design, energy optimisation, cost estimation, and visualization.
overview: Final-year project focused on developing a sustainable institutional building with reduced energy demand while maintaining structural safety and functional efficiency. The workflow progressed from site assessment to analysis, simulation, and documentation following NBC, KMBR, and relevant IS codes.
objectives: Minimize operational energy demand using passive design strategies || Ensure structural safety and code compliance || Develop a coordinated BIM model (LOD 350) || Generate accurate quantity take-offs and cost estimation
